## 2. Core Service Offerings & Pricing Rules
Pricing is calculated deterministically in integer Indian Paise (1 INR = 100 paise) following strict precedence:
1. Vendor Approved Override
2. City Override (Delhi, Shahjahanpur, Kanpur)
3. Base Catalog Price

### Master Categories (12 Categories, 110 Bookable Variants):
1. Water Tank Cleaning (cat_tank_cleaning): 500L, 1000L, 1500L, 2000L, 5000L overhead & underground tanks.
2. Electrician Services (cat_electrician): 53 variants covering switchboards, ceiling fans, concealed wiring, MCB distribution boards, smart switches, inverters.
3. Plumber & Sanitary (cat_plumber): 18 variants covering tap replacement, shower installations, washbasin repair, siphon/waste pipe, bathroom drainage, RO water filter connections.
4. Painter & Wall Care (cat_painter): 1-wall accent, full room, exterior weatherproof coating, waterproof primer coats.
5. Carpenter Services (cat_carpenter): Lock installation, bed assembly, modular kitchen hinge adjustment, curtain rod drilling.
6. AC Service & Repair (cat_ac_service): Split AC jet pump service, window AC deep wash, gas leak check, PCB diagnostics.
7. Sofa, Mattress & Carpet (cat_sofa_mattress): 3-seater, 5-seater sofa foam wash, single/queen/king mattress vacuuming, carpet extraction.
8. Kitchen Deep Cleaning (cat_kitchen): Chimney degreasing, refrigerator interior/exterior cleaning, modular cabinet scrub.
9. Bathroom & Tile Cleaning (cat_bathroom): Machine floor buffing, grout descaling, toilet bowl sanitization.
10. Fan, Floor & Home Care (cat_fan_appliances): High-reach ceiling fan degreasing, balcony floor machine scrubbing.
11. Car & Bike Wash (cat_vehicle_wash): Hatchback, sedan, SUV doorstep foam wash and interior vacuum.
12. Beedare Skin & Aesthetics (cat_aesthetics): Aesthetic skin peels, Dermapen rejuvenation, salon aesthetics.

## 3. Public API Endpoints
- `GET /api/public/catalog`: Returns categories, services, and base prices
- `GET /api/public/lookup-pin?pin=XXXXXX`: Returns serviceability status, city, and active vendor count
- `POST /api/public/calculate-quote`: Accepts `{ serviceId, variantId, pinCode, couponCode, addonIds }` and returns authoritative price in paise
- `POST /api/public/contact`: Submits customer support / service inquiry
- `GET /api/mcp`: Lightweight MCP server tool definitions
- `GET /llms.txt`: Summary of site and services for LLMs

## 4. MCP Server Card
- Located at: `/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json`
- Supports WebMCP in-browser tools and server-to-server AI agents.
